Oto przykład złożonego zapytania SQL, które demonstruje wiele zaawansowanych funkcji:

```sql
WITH monthly_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date) AS sale_month,
        c.customer_id,
        c.customer_name,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS monthly_total,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date) 
                           ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) DESC) AS rank
    FROM customers c
    INNER JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    INNER JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    WHERE o.order_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 12 MONTH)
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date), c.customer_id, c.customer_name
),
top_customers AS (
    SELECT 
        sale_month,
        customer_id,
        customer_name,
        monthly_total,
        order_count,
        LAG(monthly_total) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id 
                                ORDER BY sale_month) AS prev_month_total,
        ROUND(((monthly_total - LAG(monthly_total) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id 
                                                         ORDER BY sale_month)) 
               / LAG(monthly_total) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id 
                                         ORDER BY sale_month) * 100), 2) AS month_over_month_growth
    FROM monthly_sales
    WHERE rank <= 10
)
SELECT 
    sale_month,
    customer_id,
    customer_name,
    monthly_total,
    order_count,
    COALESCE(month_over_month_growth, 0) AS growth_percentage,
    CASE 
        WHEN monthly_total > 10000 THEN 'Premium'
        WHEN monthly_total > 5000 THEN 'Gold'
        WHEN monthly_total > 1000 THEN 'Silver'
        ELSE 'Bronze'
    END AS customer_tier
FROM top_customers
ORDER BY sale_month DESC, monthly_total DESC;
```

**Zaawansowane funkcje używane w tym zapytaniu:**

- **CTE (Common Table Expressions)** – `WITH` klauzule dla czytelności
- **Window Functions** – `ROW_NUMBER()`, `LAG()` dla analizy danych
- **Aggregation** – `SUM()`, `COUNT()` z `GROUP BY`
- **JOIN** – połączenie wielu tabel
- **CASE WHEN** – warunkowa logika do kategoryzacji
- **Date Functions** – `DATE_TRUNC()`, `DATE_SUB()` do pracy z datami
- **Analiza trendu** – obliczanie wzrostu miesiąc do miesiąca

Zapytanie analizuje top 10 klientów każdego miesiąca w ostatnim roku, oblicza wzrost sprzedaży i przypisuje tier na podstawie wartości transakcji.

Jako analityk hurtowni danych, przygotowuję zapytanie zorientowane na business intelligence z fokusem na optymalizację i skalowalne rozwiązania:

```sql
WITH date_spine AS (
    -- Generowanie kalendarza dni dla analizy
    SELECT DATE_ADD('2025-01-01', INTERVAL seq DAY) AS calendar_date
    FROM (
        SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.n) - 1 AS seq
        FROM (SELECT 1 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3) t1
        CROSS JOIN (SELECT 1 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3) t2
    ) numbers
    WHERE DATE_ADD('2025-01-01', INTERVAL seq DAY) < CURDATE()
),
daily_metrics AS (
    -- Metryki dzienne na poziomie produktu i kategorii
    SELECT 
        ds.calendar_date,
        p.product_id,
        p.product_name,
        pc.category_id,
        pc.category_name,
        COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) AS qty_sold,
        COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 0) AS revenue,
        COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * p.cost_price), 0) AS cost_of_goods,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS unique_customers
    FROM date_spine ds
    LEFT JOIN orders o ON CAST(o.order_date AS DATE) = ds.calendar_date
    LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    LEFT JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    LEFT JOIN product_categories pc ON p.category_id = pc.category_id
    WHERE ds.calendar_date >= '2025-01-01'
    GROUP BY ds.calendar_date, p.product_id, p.product_name, pc.category_id, pc.category_name
),
category_performance AS (
    -- Analiza wydajności kategorii z metrami kluczowymi
    SELECT 
        DATE_TRUNC('week', calendar_date) AS week_start,
        category_id,
        category_name,
        SUM(qty_sold) AS weekly_qty,
        SUM(revenue) AS weekly_revenue,
        SUM(cost_of_goods) AS weekly_cogs,
        ROUND((SUM(revenue) - SUM(cost_of_goods)) / SUM(revenue) * 100, 2) AS gross_margin_pct,
        SUM(order_count) AS total_orders,
        ROUND(SUM(revenue) / NULLIF(SUM(order_count), 0), 2) AS aov,
        SUM(unique_customers) AS unique_buyers,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('week', calendar_date) 
                          ORDER BY SUM(revenue) DESC) AS category_rank,
        LAG(SUM(revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY category_id 
                               ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('week', calendar_date)) AS prev_week_revenue,
        ROUND(((SUM(revenue) - LAG(SUM(revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY category_id 
                                                       ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('week', calendar_date)))
               / LAG(SUM(revenue)) OVER (PARTITION BY category_id 
                                        ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('week', calendar_date)) * 100), 1) AS wow_growth_pct
    FROM daily_metrics
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('week', calendar_date), category_id, category_name
),
quality_metrics AS (
    -- Wskaźniki jakości i anomalii
    SELECT 
        week_start,
        category_id,
        category_name,
        weekly_revenue,
        weekly_qty,
        aov,
        STDDEV_POP(weekly_revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY category_id 
                                        ORDER BY week_start 
                                        ROWS BETWEEN 12 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS revenue_stddev,
        AVG(weekly_revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY category_id 
                                 ORDER BY week_start 
                                 ROWS BETWEEN 12 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS revenue_ma_12w,
        CASE 
            WHEN ABS(weekly_revenue - AVG(weekly_revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY category_id 
                                                                ORDER BY week_start 
                                                                ROWS BETWEEN 12 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) 
                 > 2 * STDDEV_POP(weekly_revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY category_id 
                                                        ORDER BY week_start 
                                                        ROWS BETWEEN 12 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
            THEN 'Anomaly_Detected'
            ELSE 'Normal'
        END AS data_quality_flag
    FROM category_performance
)
SELECT 
    week_start,
    category_id,
    category_name,
    weekly_revenue,
    weekly_qty,
    gross_margin_pct,
    aov,
    unique_buyers,
    wow_growth_pct,
    category_rank,
    ROUND(revenue_ma_12w, 2) AS ma_12w_revenue,
    data_quality_flag,
    CASE 
        WHEN category_rank <= 3 AND wow_growth_pct > 10 THEN 'High_Growth_Leader'
        WHEN category_rank <= 3 AND wow_growth_pct < -10 THEN 'Top_Category_Declining'
        WHEN wow_growth_pct > 20 THEN 'Strong_Growth'
        WHEN wow_growth_pct < -20 THEN 'Significant_Decline'
        ELSE 'Stable'
    END AS performance_segment
FROM quality_metrics
WHERE data_quality_flag = 'Normal'
ORDER BY week_start DESC, category_rank ASC
```

**Kluczowe cechy tej wersji:**

🎯 **Business Intelligence:**
- Metryki KPI: Revenue, Margin, AOV, Conversion Metrics
- Analiza trendów WoW i MA (Moving Average)
- Segmentacja wydajności dla podejmowania decyzji

- Agregacja wielopoziomowa (dzień → tydzień)

🔍 **Monitorowanie jakości:**

📊 **Skalowalne wzorce:**
